data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word antheia, meaning flower or blossom. In Greek mythology, Antheia was the goddess of flowers and springtime. The name Anthea carries the meaning “Graceful One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Anthea usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anthea total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אנטיאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אנטיאה נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'אנטהוס' (ἀνθος), שפירושה פרח. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'אנטה', שפירושה שושנת המים או תוספת. השם משמש כמטפורה לנערה צעירה ויפהפייה, כמו פרח פורח.

in_greek.name: Ανθεα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ανθεα προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'άνθος' (ἀνθος), που σημαίνει λουλούδι ή άνθος. Στη Βίβλο, η λέξη 'άνθος' χρησιμοποιείται ως μεταφορά για κάτι που είναι όμορφο και ευαίσθητο. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ανθεα συνδέεται με την πνευματική ανάπτυξη και την ομορφιά της ψυχής.

in_latin.name: Anthea
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Anthea derivatur a verbo Graeco 'anthos' (ἀνθος), quod significat florem. In Ecclesia primitiva, flos ut metaphoram ad virgines pulchras et innocentes referebat. Nomen Anthea significat puellam mundo et Deo dedicatam, quasi flos in virtutibus enitens.

in_english.name: Anthea
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anthea originates from the Greek word 'anthos' (ἀνθος), meaning flower. It symbolizes a young girl who is as beautiful and delicate as a flower. In Christian tradition, Anthea represents spiritual growth, purity, and innocence. Historically, the name was used in early Christian communities to signify a person's devotion to God and their virtuous character.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anthea has carried a rich cultural significance throughout history. Greek mythology held Antheia as the goddess of flowers and springtime, symbolizing new growth, beauty, and renewal. As the name suggests, an Anthea embodies a radiant and blooming spirit, emitting a warm and alluring energy. Even outside of the Greek context, the name Anthea has maintained its connection to nature and growth, offering further symbolism in various cultural backgrounds.
data.spiritual_significance: Anthea holds a special spiritual significance that transcends its cultural origins. The name serves as a reminder of the unending cycle of growth and renewal in our lives. For Christians, it can represent the spiritual regeneration experienced through faith and the grace of God. Moreover, as a symbol of love, Anthea carries the spiritual meaning of an affectionate embrace, offering solace and comfort to those in need. With its profound connection to nature, beauty, and renewal, the name Anthea invites one to cherish each moment and revel in the wonders of an ever-evolving world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Anthea, derived from the Greek word for "flower bloom," symbolizes the blossoming of spiritual growth and the sweet fragrance of faith in God. It embodies the transformation of inner beauty and the joy of sharing God's love with the world.
